examples.en: He hacked a path through the tall grass with a stick.
examples.zh: 他用一根棍子在高高的草叢中劈出一條路。

examples.en: Someone tried to hack into the school's website last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有人試圖駭入學校的網站。

examples.en: Hikers hacked away the branches that blocked the trail.
examples.zh: 登山客砍掉了擋住步道的樹枝。

examples.en: The company lost data in a serious hack last year.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年在一次嚴重的駭客攻擊中遺失了資料。

examples.en: Here is a simple hack for keeping your desk tidy.
examples.zh: 這裡有個讓書桌保持整齊的簡單小技巧。

examples.en: Experts say the hack was caused by a weak password.
examples.zh: 專家說這次入侵是由強度不足的密碼造成的。

examples.en: She changed her hairstyle before the school photo.
examples.zh: 她在拍學校照片前換了髮型。

examples.en: This hairstyle is easy to take care of in summer.
examples.zh: 這種髮型在夏天很好整理。

examples.en: My brother's new hairstyle makes him look older.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的新髮型讓他看起來比較成熟。

examples.en: The coach talked to the players at half-time.
examples.zh: 教練在中場休息時跟球員談話。

examples.en: We bought drinks and snacks during half-time.
examples.zh: 我們在中場休息時買了飲料和點心。

examples.en: The score was tied at half-time.
examples.zh: 半場結束時比數是平手。

examples.en: She has a half-time job at the library.
examples.zh: 她在圖書館有一份兼職工作。

examples.en: The clinic offers half-time positions for nurses.
examples.zh: 這間診所提供護理師半天班的職缺。

examples.en: He is looking for a half-time position near his school.
examples.zh: 他在找學校附近的兼職工作。

examples.en: Please halve the recipe if you are cooking for two.
examples.zh: 如果只有兩個人吃，請把食譜的份量減半。

examples.en: The store plans to halve its prices this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店計畫在這個週末把價格砍半。

examples.en: Halve the apple and share it with your sister.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成兩半，和你妹妹分著吃。

examples.en: Every new student receives a handbook on the first day.
examples.zh: 每位新生在第一天都會拿到一本手冊。

examples.en: The employee handbook explains the rules for taking leave.
examples.zh: 員工手冊說明了請假的規定。

examples.en: I found the answer in the safety handbook.
examples.zh: 我在安全手冊裡找到了答案。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a handout about the history test.
examples.zh: 老師發給我們一份有關歷史考試的講義。

examples.en: Please read the handout before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 請在會議開始前先閱讀這份資料。

examples.en: Volunteers gave handouts to people walking past the station.
examples.zh: 志工把傳單發給走過車站的人。

examples.en: The school has strict rules against harassment.
examples.zh: 學校對騷擾行為訂有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: She reported the harassment to her manager.
examples.zh: 她向主管通報了這起騷擾事件。

examples.en: Online harassment can hurt young people deeply.
examples.zh: 網路騷擾可能深深傷害年輕人。

examples.en: The mayor took a hardline position on illegal parking.
examples.zh: 市長對違規停車採取強硬立場。

examples.en: The company has a hardline policy on being late.
examples.zh: 公司對遲到採取嚴格不通融的政策。

examples.en: Parents disagreed with the hardline approach of the school.
examples.zh: 家長不同意學校的強硬做法。

examples.en: The hardliner refused to discuss any change to the plan.
examples.zh: 那位強硬派人士拒絕討論計畫的任何更動。

examples.en: Some hardliners in the committee voted against the deal.
examples.zh: 委員會裡有些強硬派人士投票反對這項協議。

examples.en: A hardliner may find it difficult to work with others.
examples.zh: 強硬派人士可能很難與他人合作。

examples.en: This table is made of solid hardwood.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用實心硬木做的。

examples.en: Hardwood floors are easy to clean but can be expensive.
examples.zh: 硬木地板很好清理，但價格可能偏高。

examples.en: Oak and maple are both common types of hardwood.
examples.zh: 橡木和楓木都是常見的硬木。

examples.en: These hardy plants can survive the cold winter.
examples.zh: 這些耐寒的植物能撐過寒冬。

examples.en: The hardy hikers walked ten kilometers in the rain.
examples.zh: 那些強健的登山客在雨中走了十公里。

examples.en: Goats are hardy animals that live well on the hills.
examples.zh: 山羊是強健的動物，在山坡上也能生活得很好。

examples.en: Most spiders in our garden are harmless.
examples.zh: 我們花園裡的大多數蜘蛛是無害的。

examples.en: The joke was harmless, but she still felt upset.
examples.zh: 這個玩笑沒有惡意，但她還是很難過。

examples.en: This cleaner is harmless to pets and children.
examples.zh: 這款清潔劑對寵物和小孩無害。

examples.en: The small café is a haven for tired students.
examples.zh: 這間小咖啡店是疲憊學生的避風港。

examples.en: The island became a haven for wild birds.
examples.zh: 這座島成了野鳥的棲息地。

examples.en: Her room is a quiet haven after a busy day.
examples.zh: 忙碌一天後，她的房間是個安靜的避風港。

examples.en: The sign warns drivers about hazardous road conditions.
examples.zh: 標誌提醒駕駛人注意危險的路況。

examples.en: Workers must wear masks around hazardous chemicals.
examples.zh: 工作人員在有害化學物質附近必須戴口罩。

examples.en: Climbing on the wet rocks is hazardous.
examples.zh: 攀爬濕滑的岩石很危險。

examples.en: A head-on collision closed the highway for two hours.
examples.zh: 一起正面碰撞事故讓高速公路封閉了兩個小時。

examples.en: The two teams had a head-on battle in the final.
examples.zh: 兩隊在決賽中正面交鋒。

examples.en: The manager chose a head-on approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 經理選擇正面處理這個問題。

examples.en: The two cars crashed head-on near the bridge.
examples.zh: 兩輛車在橋邊迎面相撞。

examples.en: You should face your fears head-on.
examples.zh: 你應該直接面對自己的恐懼。

examples.en: She met the challenge head-on.
examples.zh: 她正面迎接了這個挑戰。

examples.en: Write the title as a heading at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 把題目寫成標題放在頁面最上方。

examples.en: The ship changed its heading to avoid the storm.
examples.zh: 這艘船改變航向以避開暴風雨。

examples.en: Each heading in the report is in bold type.
examples.zh: 報告裡的每個標題都用粗體字。

examples.en: My grandfather's hearing is not as good as before.
examples.zh: 我爺爺的聽力不如從前了。

examples.en: The hearing will take place in the city court next week.
examples.zh: 聽證會下週將在市法院舉行。

examples.en: She had her hearing tested at the clinic.
examples.zh: 她在診所做了聽力檢查。

examples.en: The two students had a heated argument about the project.
examples.zh: 兩位學生為了這項專題起了激烈的爭論。

examples.en: Heated seats make winter drives more comfortable.
examples.zh: 加熱座椅讓冬天開車更舒適。

examples.en: The meeting became heated after the new proposal.
examples.zh: 新提案提出後，會議氣氛變得火熱。

examples.en: The heating in our classroom is broken again.
examples.zh: 我們教室的暖氣又壞了。

examples.en: Turn down the heating when you go out.
examples.zh: 出門時請把暖氣調低。

examples.en: Heating costs more in the northern part of the country.
examples.zh: 這個國家北部的暖氣費用比較高。

examples.en: He heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
examples.zh: 他用力把沉重的箱子抬上貨車。

examples.en: The sailors heaved on the rope together.
examples.zh: 水手們一起用力拉繩子。

examples.en: She heaved a sigh and closed her book.
examples.zh: 她嘆了一口氣，闔上書。

examples.en: With one heave, they moved the table aside.
examples.zh: 他們使勁一推，就把桌子移到旁邊。

examples.en: A big heave brought the net out of the water.
examples.zh: 用力一拉，就把漁網拉出水面。

examples.en: Give the door a heave if it sticks.
examples.zh: 門如果卡住，就用力推一下。

senses.zh: 重量級選手；舉足輕重的人物

examples.en: He trained hard to become a heavyweight boxing champion.
examples.zh: 他努力訓練，想成為重量級拳擊冠軍。

examples.en: The company is a heavyweight in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 這家公司是時尚業的重量級企業。

examples.en: She is a heavyweight in the field of medicine.
examples.zh: 她是醫學界舉足輕重的人物。

examples.en: The heavyweight match drew a large crowd.
examples.zh: 重量級比賽吸引了大批觀眾。

examples.en: This heavyweight coat will keep you warm all winter.
examples.zh: 這件厚重的外套能讓你整個冬天都保暖。

examples.en: The book offers a heavyweight discussion of world history.
examples.zh: 這本書對世界史有分量十足的討論。

examples.en: You should heed your teacher's advice before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前你應該聽從老師的建議。

examples.en: Drivers must heed the warning signs on the road.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須留意路上的警告標誌。

examples.en: He did not heed the doctor's warning about sugar.
examples.zh: 他沒有把醫生關於糖分的警告放在心上。

examples.en: Pay heed to the safety instructions on the label.
examples.zh: 請注意標籤上的安全說明。

examples.en: She took no heed of the loud noise outside.
examples.zh: 她完全沒理會外面的吵鬧聲。

examples.en: Give heed to the rules of the pool.
examples.zh: 請留意泳池的規則。

examples.en: The baby bird was helpless without its mother.
examples.zh: 沒有母鳥在身邊，小鳥顯得無助。

examples.en: I felt helpless when my friend was in trouble.
examples.zh: 朋友遇到麻煩時，我覺得很無能為力。

examples.en: The farmers were helpless against the flood.
examples.zh: 農民面對洪水束手無策。

examples.en: Henceforth, all visitors must sign in at the front desk.
examples.zh: 從今以後，所有訪客都必須在櫃檯簽到。

examples.en: The school announced that henceforth phones will be kept in lockers.
examples.zh: 學校宣布今後手機要放在置物櫃裡。

examples.en: She promised to be on time henceforth.
examples.zh: 她保證從現在起會準時。

examples.en: The first flowers are a herald of spring.
examples.zh: 第一批花朵是春天來臨的預兆。

examples.en: The new phone was a herald of a new age.
examples.zh: 這款新手機是新時代的先驅。

examples.en: Early songs by the band were heralds of its later success.
examples.zh: 這個樂團早期的歌曲是日後成功的前兆。

examples.en: Dark clouds herald a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示著一場大風雨。

examples.en: The company will herald the new product next month.
examples.zh: 公司將在下個月宣布新產品。

examples.en: The bell heralded the start of the festival.
examples.zh: 鐘聲宣告慶典開始。

examples.en: The seller is called the company hereafter.
examples.zh: 賣方以下簡稱為公司。

examples.en: Hereafter, please send all questions by email.
examples.zh: 今後請以電子郵件寄送所有問題。

examples.en: The rules will apply to all members hereafter.
examples.zh: 這些規定今後適用於所有會員。

examples.en: The old hermit lived alone in a cabin on the mountain.
examples.zh: 那位老隱士獨自住在山上的小木屋裡。

examples.en: After the move, he became something of a hermit.
examples.zh: 搬家以後，他變得有點離群索居。

examples.en: The story is about a hermit who loved books.
examples.zh: 這個故事是關於一位愛書的隱士。

examples.en: Sheep were eating grass on the hillside.
examples.zh: 羊群正在山坡上吃草。

examples.en: Our house sits on a quiet hillside near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們家坐落在湖邊一處安靜的山坡上。

examples.en: Small tea farms cover the hillside.
examples.zh: 小型茶園佈滿了整片山坡。

examples.en: Heavy rain may hinder the rescue work.
examples.zh: 大雨可能會妨礙救援工作。

examples.en: Noise from the street can hinder your study.
examples.zh: 街上的噪音可能會妨礙你念書。

examples.en: Poor communication will hinder the team's progress.
examples.zh: 溝通不良會阻礙團隊的進度。

examples.en: The door hinge needs a little oil.
examples.zh: 這扇門的鉸鏈需要上一點油。

examples.en: A broken hinge kept the window from closing.
examples.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈讓窗戶關不起來。

examples.en: The box opens on a small metal hinge.
examples.zh: 這個盒子靠一個小金屬鉸鏈開合。

examples.en: Our plan hinges on the weather.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫取決於天氣。

examples.en: Everything hinges on whether she can come.
examples.zh: 一切都取決於她能不能來。

examples.en: The result hinges on one final test.
examples.zh: 結果取決於最後一次測驗。

examples.en: The snake began to hiss when we got close.
examples.zh: 我們靠近時，蛇開始發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: Steam hissed from the old kettle.
examples.zh: 蒸汽從舊水壺裡嘶嘶地冒出來。

examples.en: The cat hissed at the strange dog.
examples.zh: 貓對著陌生的狗發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: We heard a hiss coming from the tire.
examples.zh: 我們聽到輪胎傳來嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: The hiss of the radio made it hard to hear.
examples.zh: 收音機的雜音讓人很難聽清楚。

examples.en: A long hiss came from the pot.
examples.zh: 鍋子裡傳出一陣長長的嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: The fund sold its holding in the company last year.
examples.zh: 這檔基金去年出售了該公司的持股。

examples.en: The library has a large holding of old maps.
examples.zh: 圖書館館藏有大量舊地圖。

examples.en: Her family's land holding is near the river.
examples.zh: 她家的土地持有地靠近河邊。

examples.en: The city opened a shelter for homeless people.
examples.zh: 市政府為無家可歸的人開設了收容所。

examples.en: The fire left many families homeless.
examples.zh: 那場火災讓許多家庭無家可歸。

examples.en: We gave warm clothes to the homeless children.
examples.zh: 我們把保暖衣物送給無家可歸的孩子。

examples.en: The town has a fairly homogeneous population.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的人口組成相當單一。

examples.en: Stir until the mixture is homogeneous.
examples.zh: 攪拌到混合物均勻為止。

examples.en: A homogeneous class is easier to teach in some ways.
examples.zh: 程度相近的班級在某些方面比較好教。

examples.en: The driver honked at the car in front of him.
examples.zh: 司機對著前面的車按了喇叭。

examples.en: Geese honk loudly as they fly south.
examples.zh: 鵝群往南飛時會大聲嘎嘎叫。

examples.en: Please do not honk near the hospital.
examples.zh: 請不要在醫院附近按喇叭。

examples.en: We heard the honk of a taxi outside.
examples.zh: 我們聽到外面有計程車的喇叭聲。

examples.en: A loud honk made me jump.
examples.zh: 一聲響亮的喇叭聲嚇了我一跳。

examples.en: The honk of geese filled the lake.
examples.zh: 鵝群的叫聲迴盪在湖面上。

examples.en: She pulled up her hood because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，她把兜帽拉了起來。

examples.en: The mechanic opened the hood to check the engine.
examples.zh: 技師打開引擎蓋檢查引擎。

examples.en: A warm coat with a hood is good for winter.
examples.zh: 有兜帽的暖外套很適合冬天。

examples.en: The horse hurt its hoof on a sharp stone.
examples.zh: 那匹馬的蹄被尖銳的石頭弄傷了。

examples.en: We heard the sound of hooves on the road.
examples.zh: 我們聽到路上傳來馬蹄聲。

examples.en: A farmer cleans each hoof carefully.
examples.zh: 農夫仔細清理每一隻蹄。

examples.en: He felt hopeless after failing the test twice.
examples.zh: 考試連續兩次沒過，他感到絕望。

examples.en: The situation looked hopeless at first.
examples.zh: 一開始情況看起來毫無希望。

examples.en: I am hopeless at cooking, so I order take-out.
examples.zh: 我很不會做菜，所以都叫外賣。

examples.en: The engine of this truck has 300 horsepower.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車的引擎有三百馬力。

examples.en: More horsepower does not always mean a faster car.
examples.zh: 馬力較大不一定代表車子比較快。

examples.en: The motorbike was tested for its horsepower.
examples.zh: 這輛機車接受了馬力測試。

examples.en: The hound followed the smell along the river.
examples.zh: 獵犬沿著河邊追隨著氣味。

examples.en: A hound can find a path in the dark forest.
examples.zh: 獵犬能在黑暗的森林裡找到路。

examples.en: Our neighbor keeps a hound on his farm.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居在他的農場養了一隻獵犬。

examples.en: Reporters hounded the actor for an interview.
examples.zh: 記者不斷糾纏那位演員要求採訪。

examples.en: The debt hounded him for years.
examples.zh: 這筆債務多年來一直困擾著他。

examples.en: Don't hound your little brother about his homework.
examples.zh: 不要一直催你弟弟寫功課。

examples.en: Workers painted the hull of the ship white.
examples.zh: 工人把船體漆成白色。

examples.en: A small hole in the hull let water in.
examples.zh: 船體上的一個小洞讓水滲了進來。

examples.en: Remove the hull of the strawberry before eating.
examples.zh: 吃草莓前先去掉蒂頭。

examples.en: The group sends humanitarian aid to flood areas.
examples.zh: 這個團體把人道援助送往水災地區。

examples.en: She won a prize for her humanitarian work.
examples.zh: 她因為人道工作獲得一個獎項。

examples.en: The school raised money for a humanitarian project.
examples.zh: 學校為一項人道專案募款。

examples.en: He is known as a humanitarian who helps children.
examples.zh: 他是以幫助兒童聞名的人道主義者。

examples.en: The humanitarian visited several refugee camps.
examples.zh: 這位人道主義者走訪了幾個難民營。

examples.en: Many humanitarians work without pay.
examples.zh: 許多人道主義者不領薪水工作。

examples.en: She felt great humiliation when she forgot her speech.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時覺得非常丟臉。

examples.en: The team suffered a humiliation in the final match.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中遭到慘敗的羞辱。

examples.en: He could not forget the humiliation of that day.
examples.zh: 他忘不了那天所受的羞辱。

examples.en: He hurled the ball over the fence.
examples.zh: 他把球用力扔過圍牆。

examples.en: The pitcher hurled the ball as hard as he could.
examples.zh: 投手使出全力投出那顆球。

examples.en: Waves hurled the little boat against the rocks.
examples.zh: 海浪把小船猛力推向岩石。

examples.en: The choir sang a hymn at the morning service.
examples.zh: 合唱團在早晨的禮拜中唱了一首聖歌。

examples.en: We learned an old hymn in music class.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂課學了一首古老的聖歌。

examples.en: Her grandmother hummed a hymn while cooking.
examples.zh: 她奶奶煮飯時哼著聖歌。

examples.en: He was angry at the hypocrisy of the leader.
examples.zh: 他對那位領導者的偽善感到憤怒。

examples.en: Telling others to read while never reading is hypocrisy.
examples.zh: 叫別人讀書自己卻從不讀書，就是虛偽。

examples.en: The article criticizes the hypocrisy of some brands.
examples.zh: 這篇文章批評某些企業的虛偽。

senses.zh: 歇斯底里的；非常好笑的

examples.en: The crowd became hysterical when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手一出現，群眾就陷入瘋狂。

examples.en: She was hysterical with fear during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，她嚇得幾乎失控。

examples.en: The comedy was so hysterical that we laughed all night.
examples.zh: 那部喜劇實在太好笑了，我們笑了一整晚。

examples.en: The two parties have deep ideological differences.
examples.zh: 這兩個政黨在意識形態上有很大的差異。

examples.en: The book explains the ideological background of the war.
examples.zh: 這本書說明了這場戰爭的意識形態背景。

examples.en: Students discussed ideological issues in class.
examples.zh: 學生在課堂上討論了意識形態的議題。

examples.en: A small spark can ignite dry grass.
examples.zh: 一點小火花就能點燃乾草。

examples.en: The speech ignited a debate among students.
examples.zh: 這場演講引發了學生之間的辯論。

examples.en: Be careful not to ignite the gas near the stove.
examples.zh: 小心不要在爐子附近點燃瓦斯。

examples.en: Immerse the cloth in warm water for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把布浸在溫水中十分鐘。

examples.en: She immersed herself in her studies before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前她全心投入功課。

examples.en: Living abroad helps you immerse yourself in the language.
examples.zh: 住在國外能讓你沉浸在語言環境中。
